+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    'author_fields',
+    [

+        {'author_name': ['Author']},
+        {'author_key': [], 'author_name': []},
+    ],
+)
+def test_make_work_without_authors(author_fields):
+    doc = {'title': 'A work', **author_fields}
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert isinstance(work, web.Storage)
+    assert work.title == 'A work'
+    assert work.authors == []
+    assert work.cover_url == '/images/icons/avatar_book-sm.png'
+    assert work.ia == []
+    assert work.first_publish_year is None
+    for field, value in doc.items():
+        assert work[field] == value
+
+
+def test_make_work_preserves_metadata_and_creates_authors(monkeypatch):
+    web.ctx.site = MockSite()
+    created = []
+
+    def new_author(path, data):
+        author = object()
+        created.append((path, data, author))
+        return author
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web.ctx.site, 'new', new_author)
+    doc = {
+        'title': 'A work',
+        'author_key': ['OL1A', 'OL2A'],
+        'author_name': ['First', 'Second'],
+        'cover_url': '/covers/1.jpg',
+        'ia': ['identifier'],
+        'first_publish_year': 2001,
+    }
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert work.authors == [entry[2] for entry in created]
+    assert [(path, data) for path, data, _ in created] == [
+        (
+            '/authors/OL1A',
+            {'key': '/authors/OL1A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'First'},
+        ),
+        (
+            '/authors/OL2A',
+            {'key': '/authors/OL2A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'Second'},
+        ),
+    ]
+    assert work.cover_url == '/covers/1.jpg'
+    assert work.ia == ['identifier']
